reapack.name: reaper_reacord.ext
reapack.desc: ReaCord: Discord Rich Presence for REAPER

version.name: 1.0.3-beta6
version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Fixes for UI Switcher & Preference: + Fix ReaImGui window lingering on screen when switching to classic Win32 dialog (destroy context & defer) + Fix preference persistence for Extensions menu default UI (remove reset bug, reload config before opening dialog) + Synchronize ExtState directly in SetConfig to guarantee consistency across C++ and ReaScript

version.name: 1.0.3-beta5
version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Dual Interface & 1-Click Launch: + Seamless in-dialog toggle between Classic Win32 dialog and Modern ReaImGui on Windows + Direct 1-click launch of ReaImGui companion script from Extensions menu on macOS and Linux + Option to remember preferred settings interface (Classic or ReaImGui) for Extensions menu + Dedicated REACORD_OPEN_SETTINGS_NATIVE and REACORD_OPEN_SETTINGS_REAIMGUI actions

version.name: 1.0.3-beta4
version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Padding & Layout Refinements: + Fixed bottom whitespace under action buttons in Windows settings dialog + Clean 8-DLU bottom margin matching dialog side margins and button proportions + Dynamic DPI-independent collapse/expand delta matching control boundaries exactly

version.name: 1.0.3-beta3
version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Design & Layout Polish: + Discord Client ID moved into Advanced Settings for an ultra-clean main panel + Dedicated full-width status row preventing any text wrapping, clipping, or button collisions + Fixed literal ampersands (&&) across all Win32 dialog controls + Balanced action button bar (Help on left, OK/Cancel/Apply on right) + Compact default dialog height (only 198 DLUs) with smooth expansion

version.name: 1.0.3-beta2
version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Experimental Beta 2: + Collapsible Advanced Settings section in both Native SWELL dialog and ReaImGui companion + ExtState Section & Key configuration tucked neatly out of the way + Auto-expands Advanced configuration when Project Active Time (ExtState) is selected + Clean, compact default layout for standard usage

version.name: 1.0.3-beta1
version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Experimental Beta: + Project Active Time tracking via Project ExtState (replaces tab uptime with true logged work time) + Smart duration parser: supports integer/float seconds and HH:MM:SS / MM:SS strings + Configurable ExtState Section and Key in both Native SWELL and ReaImGui settings + Option to append tracked active time badge to presence playback status + Live ExtState preview in ReaImGui companion window

version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Logo Customization Release: + Profile Card Logo selection: choose between Classic REAPER guitar pick and ReaCord hybrid emblem + Configurable in both native SWELL dialog and ReaImGui companion

version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Security & Asset Release: + Security hardening: named pipe client impersonation defense (SECURITY_SQOS_PRESENT) + Safe bounded memory allocation for incoming IPC frames + Thread-local string buffers for ReaScript C API exports + Robust numeric sanitization for custom Discord Client IDs + Compiler & linker exploit mitigations (ASLR, DEP, Control Flow Guard, Stack Canaries) + New official diagonal-split ReaCord emblem combining REAPER and Discord + Terms of Service & Privacy Policy for Discord Developer Portal verification

version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Initial Release: + Native C++ Discord Rich Presence extension for REAPER + Zero external processes required + Granular privacy controls (Project Name, Session Time, Play State, Track Count) + Instant Incognito stealth mode + Dual GUI: Native SWELL dialog + ReaImGui live preview companion + Ultra-lightweight asynchronous architecture with zero audio latency impact
